note.question: What role does multiplayer allocations play in the presence of diminishing marginal contributions?
note.overview: We use cooperative game theory to investigate multiplayer allocation problems under the almost diminishing marginal contributions (ADMC) property. This property indicates that a player’s marginal contribution to a non-empty coalition decreases as the size of the coalition increases. The paper develops ADMC games for such problems and derive a necessary and sufficient condition for the non-emptiness of the core.
